limitations: This artifact records deterministic text expectations and a manual baseline/candidate scenario review. It does not execute an LLM, measure stochastic adherence, or claim repeated model/runtime trials. Repeated trials remain required when supported and behavior nondeterminism materially matters.

cases.candidate_expectation: The entry slice continues through outcome verification, applicable audit/E2E, exact-head CI and lifecycle closeout rather than stopping at patch/PR/merge.
must_contain: Complete the current entry slice from live state through implementation or documentation, validation, outcome verification
A patch, PR, green partial CI, merge or archived task is a milestone, not by itself the end of the owner invocation

`CHANGED_PATHS`, `AUDIT`, `E2E`, `PR_HYGIENE`, `LAST_PROGRESS`, `BUDGET`, `UNCHANGED_STATE`

cases.baseline_risk: Prompt 1.1 could be read as requiring classification of every later programme entry even after an earlier READY candidate was proven.
cases.candidate_expectation: Classify all siblings in the current mixed entry, then stop scanning later numbered entries immediately after selecting the first canonical READY candidate.
must_contain: ordered short-circuiting
stop selector traversal immediately

cases.baseline_risk: A duplicated queue could drift from the canonical programme.

is the sole selection authority
